g1-implement.title: Inherit-gold-fusion mode (flag-gated, test-led): implement
g1-implement.imperative: Fill templates/IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF.template.md. TASK: add a flag-gated inherit-gold-fusion mode to the walk-forward pipeline. (1) render_period_config: when inherit mode is on, emit emit_fusion_train_rows = "none" (base modules only) instead of leave_one_season_out. (2) _run_downstream: when inherit mode is on, SKIP run_static_hierarchical_fusion_training.py and instead assemble the period trained manifest from the period's own gold details + the LIVE gold fusion config (params/gold/fusion/fusion.json) and calibration (params/gold/uncertainty_calibration/) via assemble_trained_sampled_runtime_manifest.py, PRESERVING the quali_pace_anchor; then run the sampled-runtime comparison against that inherited-fusion trained manifest. (3) Allow P0 (R1-6) to flow through the cutoff pipeline at cutoff=0 under inherit mode so all 4 periods score on the identical sampled-runtime path (P0 needs NO per_race_predictions export). (4) Thread the flag through scripts/run_walkforward_backtest.py (a CLI flag, default OFF) -> orchestrator -> pipeline. DEFAULT (flag off) must preserve existing per-period-LOSO behavior exactly. TEST-LED: existing tests/unit/evo_predictor/walkforward/* must stay green; add unit tests for the inherit-fusion path (config emits none; _run_downstream does NOT call fusion training and DOES point assemble at the live gold fusion config; anchor preserved; P0-at-cutoff-0 routes through the cutoff pipeline). Run py -m src.utils.simplification_limits on touched paths and pyright on touched src. Dispatch a subagent invoking constellation-implementer with the completed handoff. Wait for and integrate the returned IMPLEMENTER_RESULT.

postconditions.statement: IMPLEMENTER_RESULT returned with no unresolved blockers

default flag OFF preserves existing behavior
anchor alpha 0.5 preserved in every assembled manifest

g1-review.title: Inherit-gold-fusion mode: review
g1-review.imperative: Fill templates/REVIEWER_HANDOFF.template.md from the gate plan and IMPLEMENTER_RESULT. Verify: inherit mode emits emit_fusion_train_rows=none and does NOT invoke fusion training; assembles trained manifest from period gold details + LIVE gold fusion config with the anchor PRESERVED; P0 routes through the cutoff pipeline at cutoff=0 under inherit mode; the flag defaults OFF and the default path is byte-for-byte the prior behavior (existing tests green); new tests cover the inherit path; simplification_limits + pyright clean on touched src. Dispatch a subagent invoking constellation-reviewer. Wait for and integrate REVIEW_RESULT.

g1-integrate.title: Inherit-gold-fusion mode: integrate
g1-integrate.imperative: Check the REVIEW_RESULT verdict. APPROVE: run the walkforward unit suite, confirm green, advance. BLOCK: rework or raise a blocker. Log out-of-scope finds as triage candidates; harvest Workflow Feedback into the lesson pool.

g2-implement.title: Run walk-forward (cheap inherit flow) + author report: implement
g2-implement.imperative: COMMANDER-DRIVEN (long compute runs foreground in the commander, NOT a crew). Run the cheap inherit-gold-fusion walk-forward 2025 backtest DETACHED (Start-Process -WindowStyle Hidden), recording PID + expected artifact in .agent-work/453/findings/cmdr-470.md FIRST, then check on resume (NO watcher-sleep). When complete: score all 4 periods single-path (sampled-runtime), write reports/walkforward/walkforward_2025.summary.{json,md} (NOT overwriting multiseason_fantasy.*), compute the walk-forward total vs baseline 829 with the per-period breakdown and plain-English verdict (wash/better/worse, by how much), verify attestation_all_pass=true. Update docs/evo/analysis_refresh.md with the cheap inherit flow. Record the run evidence as an implementer-result-style note. NO subagent is dispatched for the heavy run; the commander executes it and attaches the result.

postconditions.statement: walk-forward run complete; single-path summary written; baseline comparison + verdict recorded
